reviews.warning: Review evidence is joined by exact post_id; posts count once even when multiple assets/review rows exist. These counts do not imply continuous video watch/audio review.

prospects.note: These 20 records are prospect summaries, not reference-company funding events. Funding values retain status and historical/current limits; no claim that labels are latest rounds.

definitions.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; median uses statistics.median. Missing values excluded from numeric statistics and counted separately. Zero is retained as observed zero.
definitions.date_as_of: 2026-10-22 frozen V6 as-of date; age bins are descriptive and do not normalize for exposure.
definitions.follower_counts: Source-reported author follower counts are historical profile-size values; they do not measure reach, exposure or audience size at post publication.
